The '''Hall of Contests''' was an eight-chambered [[Cave/Legends|cave]]-like complex on the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Desolate]]'' which was used as a means of testing the will of different lifeforms the Charon planned to [[Death/Legends|annihilate]]. Inside the caves were creatures that were ready to kill any [[Alien/Legends|alien]] lifeforms.
